items.investor_materiality: High: direct relevance to AVGO, AI networking and U.S.-China semiconductor restrictions.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-reported regulatory/supply-chain catalyst with a clean U.S.-equity hook.

items.news_summary: Alibaba unveiled a new AI chip and plans a model up to four times larger than its flagship; shares jumped about 5% in Reuters reporting.
items.investor_materiality: High for BABA and China-vs-Nvidia AI compute competition.

items.event_title: Nth Cycle signs $1 billion critical-minerals offtake with Glencore
items.news_summary: Nth Cycle signed a 10-year $1 billion battery-recycling minerals offtake agreement with Glencore ahead of a planned public listing.
items.investor_materiality: High thematic relevance to critical minerals, battery supply chains and U.S. industrial policy.
items.selection_reason: Large contract with clear listed-company and future-listing angle.

items.event_title: Binance buys $100 million stake in Circle
items.news_summary: Binance invested $100 million in USDC issuer Circle and expanded their partnership.
items.investor_materiality: High for CRCL, stablecoins and crypto-market infrastructure.
items.selection_reason: Fresh strategic investment in a U.S.-listed crypto infrastructure company.
